summary: Fast-entry rule for low-float, large-cap IPOs added to Nasdaq-100 methodology.

mechanism.market_cap_criterion: Must rank among the top 40 eligible non-members by market cap at assessment
mechanism.float_criterion: Low-float: qualifying names have float-adjusted market cap below a threshold relative to total market cap

mechanism.weight_ramp: Additional weight may be applied at subsequent quarterly reconstitutions as float increases
mechanism.deletion_protection: Standard deletion rules apply at reconstitution; fast-entry additions are not protected from deletion

summary: S&P 500 retains 12-month trading history and GAAP profitability requirements. No fast-entry rule adopted.

mechanism.seasoning_requirement: At least 12 months of trading history on a U.S. exchange
mechanism.profitability_requirement: Positive GAAP earnings in the most recent quarter AND positive sum of GAAP earnings over the most recent four quarters
mechanism.market_cap_threshold: Approximately $18B (floor — actual threshold may be updated; confirm in current methodology)
mechanism.float_requirement: At least 50% of shares outstanding must be publicly traded
mechanism.ipo_fast_entry: None — no fast-entry or immediate-addition pathway for IPOs
mechanism.reconstitution: Quarterly (March, June, September, December); additions and deletions at any time for corporate actions

summary: MSCI conducts quarterly index reviews (February, May, August, November effective dates). Large new listings may be added at quarterly reviews. GICS sector classification (Information Technology) required for inclusion in sector indexes.

mechanism.quarterly_reviews: February, May, August, November (announced ~6–8 weeks before effective date)
mechanism.ipo_inclusion: Eligible for next quarterly review after listing; immediate addition possible for very large IPOs at MSCI discretion
mechanism.sector_filter: Must be classified as Information Technology under the Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS)
mechanism.weighting_cap: 25/50 diversification requirement: no single name >25%, sum of names >5% cannot exceed 50%
